 THE KEEPER’S FIELD NOTES

Read. Move. Breathe.

  1. Leave the warm shapes. A circle, fan, or lane fills before striking. Only the instant it fills can deal damage.
  2. Dash through danger. Space or Dash gives 0.22 seconds of protection. It recharges in 1.25 seconds. No movement input? Dash in your last direction.
  3. Find the quiet center. The large ring has a safe opening. The floor’s thin mint ring marks your movement boundary.
  4. Survive all 54 seconds. You have three light charges. Every avoided strike earns 100 points; finishing adds 250 per remaining charge.

WASD / arrows move relative to the camera. Space dashes. P or Escape pauses. Losing focus also pauses. Calm visuals disables blinking, decorative motion, and dash ribbons.
